## Context

The consolidated Goal authorization work is merged at exact commit aa819d909a22bb98f9a9deeb1869eea7c5c2f5f3. game-api v2.2.0 is already verified in production, removing the prerequisite.

## Expected outcome

Symphony v0.1.0 is installed atomically on X1, restarted healthy, verified against the exact merge commit, and all administrative work items are closed.

## Scope

- Certify the exact merged commit with the complete QA suite
- Reserve the immutable v0.1.0 release and single Goal deployment
- Install the verified escript on X1 and restart bos-orchestrator.service
- Verify service health and publish the GitHub release

## Out of scope

- Unrelated Symphony changes
- Vercel deployment
- Changes to production credentials

## Acceptance criteria

- Exact commit aa819d909a22bb98f9a9deeb1869eea7c5c2f5f3 passes the complete QA suite
- v0.1.0 points to the exact merge commit
- bos-orchestrator.service runs the new artifact successfully
- DeploymentVerification passes and the release is published
- All Goal and Issue records are closed
